text:
The dental clinic is located on the bend at the entrance of Soi Nawamin 43. There's a clearly visible sign.

Two dentists are on duty, but appointments are quite busy, so it's recommended to call and schedule in advance.

There is parking available in front of the clinic.
The dentists are lovely, caring, and provide good, straightforward advice.

Hot and cold water, coffee, and Milo are self-service.

restaurant_name: ทันตรักษ์ คลินิกทันตกรรม
text: The service was great. I went for a teeth cleaning. I had an appointment at noon and arrived right away; they were very punctual, unlike some places where you have to wait a long time. The dentist was gentle, spoke politely, and the procedure was quick. The price was reasonable, and the clinic was clean. It felt like getting dental work done at home. 😊😊
